description.value: Mason & Daly General Merchants is a heritage-themed general store operating within Barkerville Historic Town & Park, western North America's largest living history museum and a National Historic Site of Canada. Set in a reconstructed 1870s gold-rush townsite deep in the Cariboo Mountains, the shop would transport a touring cyclist arriving via Highway 26 into a remarkably well-preserved slice of BC's gold-rush era. The site is managed by the Barkerville Heritage Trust and hosts a range of independent merchants, restaurants, and cultural programming.
